caveat: SYNTHETIC evaluation: all questions were written by the team's coding agent from the rule texts, and the weather is a synthetic forecast. These numbers measure the router against its own authors' questions, not real farmers. Replace or verify the seed set with real farmer questions before quoting any of them.

seed.label_check: passed: every label agrees with the rule engine in its context

split.method: sha256(id) order within each (category, expected outcome, language) stratum; first 40% = dev

definitions.accuracy@k: share of items with relevant rules whose top-k retrieved rules include one of them (retrieval only)
definitions.abstention_precision: of the questions the router sent to the officer, the share that should have gone
definitions.abstention_recall: of the questions that should go to the officer, the share that did
definitions.wrong_answers: answers whose rule is not an expected one, including answers to questions that should abstain
definitions.coverage: share of answerable questions answered with an expected rule
definitions.outcome_accuracy: share of questions with the right outcome (expected rule, or abstention when expected)

index.chunking: semantic: embedding similarity between adjacent sentences
index.contextual_headers: document, section, page, pack and crop prepended to every chunk

embedder.name: multilingual-e5-small
embedder.bangla_evidence: model card metadata lists language 'bn'; the card says it 'supports 100 languages from xlm-roberta, but low-resource languages may see performance degradation'

reranker.name: gte-multilingual-reranker-base
reranker.bangla_evidence: base model card metadata lists language 'bn' among 70+ languages ('Supports over 70 languages')

selected_mode.chosen_on: dev split (SYNTHETIC): best outcome accuracy, then fewest wrong answers, then lowest latency, among the modes run on this machine
